scripted-mismatch.title: One value asked for, five returned
scripted-mismatch.question: What is the average grade in Databases in Fall 2025?
scripted-mismatch.answer: The question asks for a single value, but the query returned 5 rows.
scripted-mismatch.sql:
SELECT e.grade AS grade FROM enrollments e JOIN offerings o ON o.id = e.offering_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = o.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases' AND o.semester = '2025-Fall'

aggregate.title: Aggregation
aggregate.command: python -m agent.cli --db university.db "What is the average grade in Databases in Fall 2025?"
aggregate.question: What is the average grade in Databases in Fall 2025?
aggregate.answer: The average grade in Databases in Fall 2025 is 78.0.
aggregate.sql:
SELECT AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade
FROM enrollments e
JOIN offerings o ON o.id = e.offering_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = o.course_id
WHERE c.title = 'Databases'
  AND o.semester = '2025-Fall'

join-above-average.title: Join across four tables, with a subquery
join-above-average.command: python -m agent.cli --db university.db "Which students scored above the class average in Databases in Fall 2025?"
join-above-average.question: Which students scored above the class average in Databases in Fall 2025?
join-above-average.answer: Arta, Blerim, and Dren scored above the class average in Databases in Fall 2025.
join-above-average.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name
FROM students AS s
JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.student_id = s.id
JOIN offerings AS o ON o.id = e.offering_id
JOIN courses AS c ON c.id = o.course_id
WHERE c.title = 'Databases'
  AND o.semester = '2025-Fall'
  AND e.grade > (
      SELECT AVG(e2.grade)
      FROM enrollments AS e2
      JOIN offerings AS o2 ON o2.id = e2.offering_id
      JOIN courses AS c2 ON c2.id = o2.course_id
      WHERE c2.title = 'Databases'
        AND o2.semester = '2025-Fall'
  )

filter-semester.title: Filter by semester
filter-semester.command: python -m agent.cli --db university.db "How many enrolments are there in Spring 2026?"
filter-semester.question: How many enrolments are there in Spring 2026?
filter-semester.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count
FROM enrollments AS e
JOIN offerings AS o ON o.id = e.offering_id
WHERE o.semester = '2026-Spring';

filter-teacher.title: Filter by teacher
filter-teacher.command: python -m agent.cli --db university.db "What is the average grade in the classes taught by Besnik Krasniqi?"
filter-teacher.question: What is the average grade in the classes taught by Besnik Krasniqi?
filter-teacher.answer: The average grade in classes taught by Besnik Krasniqi is 91.33333333333333.
filter-teacher.sql:
SELECT AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade
FROM enrollments AS e
JOIN offerings AS o ON e.offering_id = o.id
JOIN teachers AS t ON o.teacher_id = t.id
WHERE t.name = 'Besnik Krasniqi'

filter-student.title: Filter by student
filter-student.command: python -m agent.cli --db university.db "Which courses did Arta take, and what grade did she get in each?"
filter-student.question: Which courses did Arta take, and what grade did she get in each?
filter-student.answer: Arta took CS101 Databases and got 95.0, CS102 Algorithms and got 98.0, and CS201 Machine Learning and got 99.0.
filter-student.sql:
SELECT c.code AS course_code, c.title AS course_title, e.grade AS grade
FROM students AS s
JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.student_id = s.id
JOIN offerings AS o ON o.id = e.offering_id
JOIN courses AS c ON c.id = o.course_id
WHERE s.name = 'Arta'

library.title: A different database, same agent
library.command: python -m agent.cli --db library.db "Which books are currently on loan?"
library.question: Which books are currently on loan?
library.answer: The books currently on loan are Emma, Dune, and Dracula.
library.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.title AS book_title
FROM books AS b
JOIN loans AS l ON l.book_id = b.id
WHERE l.returned_on IS NULL
